basic_info.description: Pride of ownership is evident in this beautifully upgraded and maintained detached single-family home.  At the street level, an open porch with bench welcomes you. In the entry, wood stairs lead up to the main living floor; to the left, a hall, accesses the third bedroom and a large garage with ample storage and the laundry area.  The main living floor boasts original hardwood floors and wonderful light.  There are two bedrooms and one bath on this level, as well as a generous living/dining room with fireplace, an original, super clean, mid-century kitchen complete with electric stovetop and separate oven.  The site backs up to city property, so no neighbors, AND, if you've ever dreamt of being near a rock wall, just look out the back window!  The whole package combines so that you can enjoy a secluded, tranquil location.  Convenient to Mollie Stones, coffee, and West Portal shopping
